description: This file defines a model class for interacting with order status data in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for retrieving single or multiple order status records from the database, with caching implemented for efficiency.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Model class providing methods to retrieve order status data from the database in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: getOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order status record by ID from the database.

methods.name: getOrderStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all order status records from the database with caching.
